name: Roswell Incident
description: Ranch foreman Mac Brazel found unusual debris; the Roswell Army Air Field announced recovery of a 'flying disc', retracted within a day in favour of a weather balloon. Identified in 1994 as Project Mogul's classified acoustic balloon array. The 30-year-later revival of the story created modern UFO-crash mythology.

name: Tunguska Event
description: An explosion of roughly 10–15 megatons flattened 2,000 km² of forest with no crater. Scientific consensus: the airburst of a stony asteroid or comet fragment ~5–10 km up. Its remoteness and crater absence spawned alternatives from antimatter to alien craft, all unsupported by the tree-fall pattern and microparticle evidence.

name: Dyatlov Pass Incident
description: Nine experienced hikers died after cutting their way out of their tent at night in −25°C; some had severe internal injuries. Soviet files blamed an 'unknown compelling force', breeding infrasound, weapons-test, and yeti theories. 2019–2021 investigations and published slab-avalanche modelling support a small delayed avalanche plus hypothermia — contested but physically consistent.

name: Assassination of John F. Kennedy
description: Kennedy was shot during a motorcade through Dealey Plaza; Lee Harvey Oswald was arrested within hours and murdered by Jack Ruby two days later — the killing of the suspect on live television doing more than anything to entrench doubt. The evidentiary record (Zapruder film, ballistics, acoustics) has been contested item by item for six decades.

name: Watergate
description: A real conspiracy from break-in to cover-up, run from the White House and proven by tapes, testimony, and journalism — forcing Nixon's resignation. The permanent rejoinder to 'a conspiracy that big couldn't stay secret': it didn't.

name: Gulf of Tonkin Incident
description: The reported 4 August attack on US destroyers — used to pass the resolution escalating the Vietnam War — did not happen as described: NSA historical analysis released in 2005 concluded no attack occurred that night and intelligence was skewed. A documented case of a war justified partly on a phantom event.

name: Operation Northwoods Proposal
description: Joint Chiefs of Staff memoranda proposing false-flag operations — staged attacks to be blamed on Cuba as pretext for invasion — rejected by Kennedy and declassified in 1997. The standing proof that false-flag *proposals* reached the highest levels, routinely cited far beyond what the documents show was ever done.

name: Tuskegee Syphilis Study
description: The US Public Health Service observed untreated syphilis in 399 Black men who were deceived and denied penicillin long after it became standard care, until a whistleblower and press exposure ended it. Foundational to modern research-ethics rules — and to rational distrust that later medical conspiracy theories exploit.

name: Media, PA FBI Burglary
description: Activists broke into an FBI field office and mailed the files to newspapers, revealing COINTELPRO. The burglars stayed anonymous until 2014. A pivotal demonstration that document exfiltration, not speculation, is how real conspiracies surface.

name: Snowden Disclosures
description: NSA contractor Edward Snowden's leak of classified programs documented bulk collection at global scale. Courts later ruled aspects unlawful; Congress modified authorities. Reset the plausibility baseline for surveillance claims — while also being over-generalized by theorists into 'everything is monitored'.

name: Havana Syndrome
description: US and Canadian diplomats reported sudden neurological symptoms beginning in Havana. Hypotheses have ranged from directed energy weapons to cricket sounds and functional disorders; a 2023 US intelligence assessment deemed foreign-adversary involvement 'very unlikely', which some affected officers dispute. A live case of contested causation inside government itself.

name: Disappearance of MH370
description: The Malaysia Airlines 777 vanished with 239 aboard after diverting from its route; satellite handshakes place it in the southern Indian Ocean, where confirmed debris later drifted ashore. The absence of wreckage and motive sustains hijack, pilot, and state-actor theories — a genuine unsolved event, distinct from manufactured mysteries.
